|errata_history={{Card errata/Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V)}}
This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V)]] (version 3 of 3); it is the current text. Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V)]]): Players Committee Set 0 slip sheet<ref name="eh1351-dengarwbc-0">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 3. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], captured 6 August 2016.</ref>. Dated by 6 August 2016 (the earliest preserved copy of the Set 0 slip sheet); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V) first published}} Text: “While opponent's [Reflections 2] objective on table, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Blaster Carbine (twice per battle, may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target 'hit,' and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 &gt; defense value).” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee Set 0 slip sheet<ref name="eh1351-dengarwbc-1">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 1. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], captured 4 July 2017.</ref>. Dated by 4 July 2017 (the earliest preserved copy of the errata slip); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V) first published}} The PC card image of 8 July 2018 (Holotable commit 022435b) prints the same text with the “E” mark. Text: “While opponent's [Reflections 2] objective on table, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Dengar's Blaster Carbine (twice per battle, may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target 'hit,' and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 &gt; defense value).” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “Dengar's”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-dengarwbc-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/dengarwithblastercarbine.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The Players Committee announced the remastered Virtual Set 0 images on 1 August 2022. Text: “While opponent's [Reflections 2] objective on table, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Dengar's Blaster Carbine (twice per battle, may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target 'hit,' and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 &gt; defense value).” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
